payload.text: SignInDialog is a properly-labelled modal: the panel is role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby pointing at the generated id of its <h2> title (via React.useId), it focuses the email field on open and closes on Escape, and surfaces auth errors in a role="alert" live region. The labelledby-to-title wiring (not a hard-coded string) keeps the accessible name in lockstep with the visible heading.
